newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Grande sees green light on unit listing.
newsitem.headline: Grande sees green light on unit listing.

text.p: Electronics group Grande Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it had received a "positive indication" from the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange regarding the listing for a subsidiary in Malaysia.

"The company has received positive indication from the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange to list one of its subsidiaries, Capetronic Consumer Electronic Holdings Berhad, in Malaysia," Grande said in a statement issued through the Hong Kong bourse.
"The final terms and conditions of such listing has yet to be finalised with the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange and its financial advisor," the statement said.
The company said it would make further statements regarding the listing but it gave no details.
Grande officials were not immediately available for comment.
Capetronic Consumer Electronic makes electronic consumer audio products, with a focus on developing low cost music systems.
Grande shares gained HK$0.675 or 22.3 percent to HK$3.70 at midday on Tuesday on volume of 3.75 million shares.
